steps.en: Install the package and create a Router
steps.code: python -m pip install laya · router = Router()

steps.en: Write your questions as a dict: choice, score or noul, each with its criteria
steps.zh: 把问题写成一个字典：choice、score 或 noul，各带选项说明

steps.en: Call predict with the text (or a JSON state) and the questions
steps.zh: 把正文（或一个 JSON 状态）连同问题交给 predict

steps.en: Detects the script and language and picks the English or multilingual checkpoint
steps.zh: 识别文字与语种，挑英文或多语种 checkpoint

steps.en: Downloads that checkpoint from Hugging Face on first use
steps.zh: 首次用到时从 Hugging Face 下载该 checkpoint

steps.en: Scores every option of every question in one encoder pass — no text is generated
steps.zh: 一次编码器前向就给所有问题的所有选项打分，不生成任何文字

value.en: You branch on a label plus a probability per question in tens of milliseconds, on your own machine — no LLM call, no JSON to parse
value.zh: 每道题拿到一个标签和一个概率，几十毫秒、在自己机器上——不调大模型，也不用解析 JSON
